parent_generation_queue.role: Command catalogue; covered parent streams are not executed again in the effective queue.

curriculum_pilot_queue.full_queue_continuation: Checked in execution queue and every card.

shared_budget_no_double_count.rule: Sum each parent/profile budget once; objective pilot counts are subsets, not additional corpus targets.

all_cards_roles_stop_next_and_exact_queu.scope: Explicit contract markers and exact canonical tables; not model-based semantic admission.

rag_lock_manifest_and_slices.scope: All locked fields and local slice bytes; full original source blobs are not reconstructed from excerpts.

baseline_185_rows_and_quarantine_preserv.scope: Metadata additions and explicit quarantine placement are allowed; learner text, IDs and original rationale/provenance are preserved.

prepare_all_effective_streams.instruction: Use --prepare-check after the integration owner marks the package READY.

limits: No semantic acceptance, generator output or learning measurement is asserted.
COUNT1 is a request-construction probe; paired conditional and complete routing batches use their declared first count.
External URLs outside the pinned catalog are syntax-checked, not fetched.
Historical verification report hashes are retained evidence, not tested as current package hashes.
RAG source-body links and full source blob reconstruction are outside this bounded check.
